courses.name: B.Sc. in Horticulture
courses.summary: This is the Students Traffic catalogue category for undergraduate horticulture degrees. Programmes in this category cover the production and management of fruit, vegetable, flower, plantation, spice and medicinal crops, with nursery management, post-harvest technology, plant protection and field practice. Curriculum, regulator approval, admission route and fees are set by each university and are listed on the individual programme pages.
courses.metaTitle: B.Sc. Horticulture Degrees for International Students
